The following events took place in '''60 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|YT 492727ZED]] is constructed over [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
*[[Nejaa Halcyon]] becomes a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].
*[[Jaster Mereel]] becomes [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Civil War]] begins between the [[True Mandalorians]] and the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]].<ref name="TEA" />
*[[Maur Howins]] sets a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] record of 50 goals in 50 games.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|sports/13418_2.html|Wan Approaches 50 in 50}}</ref>
*Approximate End of the [[Bitthævrian War]].<ref name="galaxywar">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
*[[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] set up a colony on [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], and tried to gather resources there. When this failed, they [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] themselves, including the warrior that would eventually become [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="CWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
*[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] is settled by [[H'kig]] refugees from [[Galand]].<ref name="TEA" />
*[[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] is constructed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SoT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref>
